result.notes: There is a large network of drinking fountains (water bubblers) dotted around the city where you can get fresh water while you're walking or cycling. Most are in parks and playgrounds while some can also be found along main roads or near tourist attractions. Our water fountains are not only useful, they are something of a tourist attraction in themselves - with some more than 100 years old.   This app contains locations of drinking fountains and their accessibility in our local area.   More information on drinking fountains (water bubblers)
